adjudication.rationale: In Jobs::PollFeed#execute, poll_feed is only called if feed_polling_enabled? && feed_polling_url.present? && embed_by_username.present?. In spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb, the "requires feed_polling_url" example only stubs SiteSetting.feed_polling_url to nil and does not stub feed_polling_enabled?. The diff also sets feed_polling_enabled default to false in config/site_settings.yml, so execute will short-circuit on the first condition and never evaluate the URL guard, making the test pass even if the feed_polling_url check were removed.
